tasks.description: Add optional identifier parameter (int | str | None) to load_agent_output() in shared/egg_contracts/orchestrator.py. When identifier is provided, construct path as {identifier}-{role.value}-output.json. Add fallback — if prefixed path does not exist, try old {role.value}-output.json path. When identifier is None, use old path directly (backward compat).

tasks.acceptance_criteria: save_agent_output(repo, role, data, identifier=871) writes to 871-{role}-output.json. save_agent_output(repo, role, data) writes to {role}-output.json.
